zh_alias: 递归归并排序；Merge sort 的经典实现
en_alias: Recursive merge sort; a standard merge-sort implementation

foundation: 数组就是一排有编号的格子；本节说“前半、后半”，只是限定看哪些格子，并不丢掉其他数。
已经有序的两排数，各自最左边就是这一排剩下的最小数。只比较这两个头，便能决定下一项该拿谁。
“递归”是对较小的一排重复同样任务。只有一个数时不用做任何事；这就是停止规则。
zh.idea: 先把大问题拆成小问题：一排分成两半，每半再分两半，直到一项一排。然后反着往回走，每次把两个已排好的小排接成一个更大的有序排。接法不是直接拼起来，而是不断比较两排还没取走的第一个数。
steps: 指定当前范围。若里面只有零项或一项，立即结束，这个范围已经有序。否则从中间分开，先排左半，再排右半；每半都照这几步做。
两半都完成后，给它们各放一个指针。指针只是记住“下一项在哪”的编号。准备能装下整个范围的临时格子，输出位置从第一个空格开始。
比较左右指针所指的数，把较小的完整记录复制到输出格，那个指针向前一格，输出位置也向前一格。遇到相等，先取左半的记录，原来的先后关系就不会颠倒。
只要两边都有剩余项就继续比较。一边取完后，另一边本来已经有序，按原次序全部复制过去，不必再两两比较。
把临时结果复制回原范围。回到上一层时，这一整排已经有序，可以和另一半用相同方法接起来。
example: 接 [4] 和 [1]：比较 4 与 1，先写 1；右边空了，再写左边的 4，得到 [1,4]。接 [3] 与 [2] 同理先写 2，再写 3，得到 [2,3]。原数组现在是 [1,4 | 2,3]。
接最后两排：头是 1、2，取 1，临时输出 [1]；左头变成 4，右头仍是 2。比较 4、2，取 2，输出 [1,2]。
右头前进成 3，比较 4、3，取 3，输出 [1,2,3]。右边已经空了，把左边的 4 接上，成为 [1,2,3,4]，再写回原数组。
zh.cost: 设 n 为记录数。每次接两排，要逐项读写，约做与这一排长度成正比的工作。同一拆分层的排合计仍是 n 项；长度反复减半约有 log₂n 层，所以基础版最好、一般、最坏都为 Θ(n log n)。Θ 表示同一增长量级。临时数组要 O(n) 格，等待返回的调用记录要 O(log n)；相等时先取左边则稳定。增加“两半边界已经顺序正确就不接”的检查后，已经有序输入可接近 Θ(n)。
zh.why: 两排各自有序后，不需要把左边每个数和右边所有数比较。每次只看两个头，读过的项就不回头，因此每层只是扫一遍。代价是需要临时存放和复制记录。
zh.use: 需要可预测的最坏速度和稳定性时很合适；稳定表示相等记录仍按输入先后出现。大记录的反复复制和临时数组需要计入实际成本。
zh.details: 两排内部有序不等于全数组有序，[1,4 | 2,3] 就是反例。只复制记录的键而丢掉附带信息不算正确排序。真正的实现通常只分配一个大临时数组，再反复使用其中相应范围。

foundation: An array is a row of numbered slots. A range means that we work on only a consecutive part of that row.
In an ordered row, the first remaining item is the smallest remaining item. Two ordered rows therefore need only their two front items compared.
Recursion means asking the same procedure to handle a smaller range. An empty range or one item stops immediately.
en.idea: Break a row in half, then break each half again until every piece has one item. Work back upward, joining two ordered pieces into a larger ordered piece. Joining is a sequence of small choices: compare the two available fronts and take the smaller.
steps: For the current range, stop at zero or one item. Otherwise split near its middle. Finish sorting the left range, then the right range, by these same instructions.

Once both ranges are ordered, remember a next-item position for each. Such a remembered position is called a pointer here; it need not be a computer memory address. Prepare temporary output slots for their combined length.

Compare the two next items. Copy the smaller complete record into the next output slot. Advance only the pointer that supplied it, then advance the output position. On equality, take the left record first.
Keep comparing while both ranges have items. If one is exhausted, copy the remaining items from the other in their existing order. Their order is already known.
Copy the temporary result back into the original range. Return to the larger task, which can now treat this whole range as an ordered input.
example: Start with [4,1,3,2]. Split into [4,1] and [3,2], then into [4], [1], [3], [2]. Singletons require no action.
Join [4] with [1]: 1 is smaller, so write 1, then the remaining 4. This gives [1,4]. Joining [3] with [2] similarly gives [2,3]. The row is now [1,4 | 2,3].
For the final join, compare 1 with 2 and write 1. The left front becomes 4. Compare 4 with 2 and write 2: output [1,2].
Compare 4 with the new right front 3 and write 3. The right side is empty, so append 4. Copy [1,2,3,4] back into the row.
en.cost: Let n count records. Joining reads and writes each item in the current range. All ranges at one splitting level contain n items in total. Repeated halving creates about log₂n levels. The basic version therefore takes Θ(n log n) time in best, typical, and worst cases; Θ means a matching growth rate. Temporary records need O(n) slots, and suspended calls need O(log n) stack space. It is stable when the left side wins ties. A boundary check that skips already ordered joins can make ordered input take Θ(n).
en.why: An item passes through each level once. We never compare every item in one side with every item in the other. Copying records and allocating the temporary area are the main additional costs.
en.use: A dependable stable sort for general records when a temporary array is affordable.
en.details: An ordered piece is not necessarily in final positions: [1,4 | 2,3] still needs work. Move whole records, including associated information. A practical version allocates one reusable temporary array rather than a new large array at every call.

zh_alias: 迭代归并排序；归并排序变体

foundation: 一项本身就有序；把长度一的两排接起来能得到长度二的有序排，再把长度二的两排接成长度四。
接两排时，两个指针分别记录两排尚未取走的头，另一个位置记录输出写到哪里。
这里用循环，意思是完成一轮后改一下排的长度，再做下一轮，不需要层层调用自己。
zh.idea: 不从大排向下拆，而从单项向上组装。先两项一组，再四项一组，再八项一组。每次只接已经有序的邻接两排；只要排长覆盖全数组，就完成了。
steps: 令当前排长 w=1。沿数组从左到右，拿最多 w 项作左排，再拿接下来的最多 w 项作右排。末尾可能不足规定长度；没有右排就保持左排。
接这两排：分别看下一项，较小的复制到临时输出，移动供给这一项的指针。相等时先取左排。某排取空后，把另一排剩余记录顺序复制过去。
把接好的范围复制回去，再向右走到下一个尚未处理的两排。一次完整扫描结束后，每个长度约 2w 的范围已经有序。
把 w 变成 2w，重新从左到右扫描。只在 w<n 时开下一轮，n 是数组项数；n 为零或一时根本不用扫描。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数。每轮把每项读写一次，排长每轮翻倍，需要约 log₂n 轮；基础版最好、一般、最坏 Θ(n log n)。Θ 表示同一增长量级。复用临时输出需 O(n) 格，循环编号只需 O(1) 控制空间，无递归栈。相等时左排先输出则稳定；增加跳过已接顺序的边界检查可改善有序输入。
zh.why: 与自顶向下归并做的主要接排工作相同，只是通过排长控制顺序。它免去调用栈，但仍要读写临时记录，不会因此自动比所有归并实现快。
zh.use: 适合希望使用明确循环、避免调用自己，或者顺序处理连续数据的实现。
zh.details: 不能假设长度是二的整数次幂。读写范围都必须截到数组末尾；示例中的第五项正是边界情况。两排完成后才允许把它们当作下一轮的有序输入。

foundation: One item is already ordered. Joining two one-item pieces creates an ordered pair; joining pairs creates ordered groups of four.
A merge pointer remembers the next unused item of a piece. The output position remembers the next empty temporary slot.
A loop repeats a round after changing its piece size. This version needs no recursive calls.
en.idea: Build upward from single items. Join neighboring pieces of size one, then two, then four, doubling the size after each complete sweep. Each sweep uses the order established by the previous sweep.
steps: Start with piece size w=1. Moving left to right, select up to w items for a left piece and up to w following items for a right piece. A short final piece is allowed. If no right piece exists, leave the left piece alone.

Join the two pieces by comparing their next unused items. Copy the smaller into temporary output and advance its source pointer. Take the left record first on a tie. When one piece ends, copy the remaining items of the other.
Copy the joined result back, then advance to the next pair of pieces. After the whole sweep, groups of up to 2w items are ordered.
Double w and repeat while w<n, where n is the number of input items. Empty and single-item arrays require no sweep.
example: Use [4,1,3,2,5]. With w=1, join [4] and [1] into [1,4], then [3] and [2] into [2,3]. The last [5] has no partner. Result: [1,4 | 2,3 | 5].
With w=2, compare the fronts of [1,4] and [2,3]. Take 1, then 2, then 3, then remaining 4. Now the row is [1,2,3,4 | 5].

With w=4, join [1,2,3,4] and [5]. The left front is smaller on four successive comparisons, so write 1,2,3,4, then the remaining 5. The whole row is [1,2,3,4,5]. The next doubled size exceeds n, so stop.
en.cost: Let n be the item count. A sweep reads and writes each participating item, and doubling needs about log₂n sweeps. Basic best, typical, and worst time are Θ(n log n), a matching growth rate. A reusable temporary array needs O(n) slots. Loop counters need O(1) space, with no recursive stack. The method is stable if left records win ties. Checks that skip already ordered boundaries can improve favorable inputs.
en.why: The same small front comparisons used by recursive merging appear here. Loop control saves recursive-call overhead, but temporary-record traffic remains.
en.use: Useful when iterative control or straightforward sequential sweeps are preferred.
en.details: Do not assume the array length is a power of two. Clip every piece boundary at the array end. The fifth item in this example shows why. A piece becomes an input for the next round only after its entire join has finished.

zh_title: 基于旋转的原地归并排序家族
zh_alias: 原地归并；本节采用逐项插入式旋转归并
en_alias: In-place merge; this section uses single-item insertion rotations

foundation: 把两段互相挪位、但保留各段内部先后，叫作旋转。[4,7 | 2] 旋转后是 [2 | 4,7]。本节只旋转右边的一个数。
“原地”在这里表示不再分配能装下整排数的副本；仍可临时拿住一个数。
左排、右排必须分别已经有序。两个当前位置分别记住尚未确认的左项和右项。
a 是这排数的名字，a[i] 就是编号 i 的格子里那项；方括号是在指定位置，不是做乘法。
zh.idea: 两排各自有序时，如果右边的头更小，就把它插到左边当前项之前。为免覆盖数据，先把右项拿在手里，再从右往左逐格把挡路的数挪一格。重复后两排连成一排。这是容易实现的旋转归并，不是高级研究版的速度保证。
steps: 先用相邻两项形成有序小排，再按长度二、四、八等接更大的邻排。一次接排中，记 i 为左排下一项位置、j 为右排开始位置，end 为两排之后的位置。编号从 0 开始，end 本身不属于范围。
只在 i<j 且 j<end 时继续。如果 a[i]≤a[j]，左项不可能大于右排任何剩余项，确认它在本范围中的顺序，令 i 加一。
若 a[j]<a[i]，先保存 x=a[j]。从 j−1 开始往回到 i，把每项移到右边一格；反着移是为了读到尚未被覆盖的旧值。再把 x 写入 i。
插入后，确认区多了一项，i 加一；左排尚未处理的项整体右移，右排新头也右移，j 加一。不要只移动 i 而忘记改 j。
一排已经全部确认时结束。剩余那排内部有序，继续保持即可。扩大排长并重复，直至整个数组有序。
example: [4,1,3,2] 先接第一对：保存 1，把 4 从位置 0 移到 1，再写 1 到 0。第二对保存 2、移 3、写 2。得到 [1,4 | 2,3]。
最后接排，i=0、j=2、end=4。1≤2，保留 1，i=1。现在 4>2，拿住位置 2 的 2，把位置 1 的 4 右移，再把 2 放在位置 1。成为 [1,2,4,3]，i=2、j=3。
比较 4 与 3，拿住 3，右移 4，再把 3 写在位置 2。成为 [1,2,3,4]，i=j=3，左排已处理完，结束。每一步拿住的值都要写回来。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数。顺序合适时，每层只逐项比较，基础最好 Θ(n log n)；若接排前检查左末项≤右首项而跳过整个接排，有序输入可达 Θ(n)。某个右项可能让很多左项右移；很多次这样的插入累计起来，通常与最坏可能达到 Θ(n²)。迭代排长控制只需 O(1) 额外空间，递归排长控制另需 O(log n) 栈。相等时保留左项，不让等值互相越过，因此稳定。
zh.why: 省下大辅助数组，却可能把同一左项挪很多遍。用二分查找更快找到插入位置，也不能免掉腾空位置时的搬动。
zh.use: 很小的范围、内存极少而必须稳定时有用；若数据很大，应了解块归并等更复杂方法。
zh.details: 不能给这个逐项挪动版本套用高级原地归并的 O(n log n) 最坏界。一般两块旋转还可先各自反转，再反转整体；三次反转之后，两块换位而内部顺序恢复。

foundation: A rotation exchanges neighboring pieces while keeping the order inside each: [4,7 | 2] becomes [2 | 4,7]. Here the right piece has just one item.
In-place means that we avoid a full second record array. Holding one displaced item is still allowed.
Before a join, the left and right pieces must each be ordered.
Notation a[i] means the item in slot i of the row named a. Brackets select a position; they do not mean multiplication.
en.idea: If the right front is smaller than the current left item, insert it there. Hold that right item, move the intervening items one slot right, then fill the opening. Repeating this action joins the two pieces without a full copy buffer. This elementary version can move many items repeatedly.
steps: Use the bottom-up schedule: first ordered pairs, then joins of size-two pieces, then size four, and so on. For one join, let i identify the next left item, j the first remaining right item, and end the position just after both pieces. Positions are zero-based.
Continue while i<j and j<end. If a[i]≤a[j], leave the left item where it is and advance i. Every remaining right item is at least its current front.
Otherwise save x=a[j]. Starting at j−1 and moving backward to i, move each item one slot right. Backward movement preserves values that have not yet been read. Write x into position i.
Advance both i and j. The inserted item is now confirmed for this range; the remaining left piece and the right boundary both shifted right.
Stop when one piece is exhausted. Its ordered counterpart needs no rearrangement. Repeat joins at larger sizes until the whole input is ordered.
example: Begin with [4,1,3,2]. For the first pair, hold 1, shift 4 right, and insert 1. Do the same with 3 and 2. The result is [1,4 | 2,3].
For the final join, i=0, j=2, end=4. Keep 1 because 1≤2 and advance i to 1. Now 4>2: hold the 2, move 4 from position 1 to 2, then write 2 at position 1. The row is [1,2,4,3], with i=2 and j=3.
Hold 3, shift 4 right, and put 3 at position 2. This gives [1,2,3,4]. Now i=j, so the remaining left piece has ended. Every held item returned to the row.
en.cost: Let n count records. Without a skip check, favorable joins still scan at about log₂n size levels: best Θ(n log n). Checking whether the left last item already precedes the right first item can give Θ(n) on ordered input. Repeated long shifts allow typical and worst Θ(n²) movement. Iterative size control needs O(1) extra space; recursive control adds O(log n) stack space. The method is stable because equal left items remain first.
en.why: Saving a copy array trades memory for movement. Binary search can reduce position-finding comparisons, but cannot remove the shifts needed to make room.
en.use: Useful for small ranges with little memory and a stability requirement.
en.details: Do not apply the guarantees of sophisticated in-place merging to this single-item version. A general two-block rotation can use three reversals: reverse each piece, then their union; the pieces change places and recover their internal order.

sources.title: WikiSort author: rotation and other tools

zh_alias: 块排序；Grailsort 与 WikiSort 是相关实现，互非别名
en_alias: Block sort; Grailsort and WikiSort are related implementations, not aliases

foundation: 块是一串连续格子。交换两块时，第一项互换、第二项互换，直到块末；不是只交换块首。
工作区临时装数据。本算法借原数据作工作区；里面的原记录仍要归还，不能被覆盖丢掉。
标签是暂放在 A 块首的不同数，表示块原先次序。真正首值与标签交换，寄存在标签区；标签次序和真正数值有不同用途。
旋转能换邻段而保留各段内部顺序：各自反转，再整体反转。[7,8 | 5,6] 经 [8,7 | 5,6]、[8,7 | 6,5] 后，整体反转成 [5,6 | 7,8]。
|A| 表示 A 中的项数；√ 表示平方根，例如 16 的平方根是 4，因为 4×4=16。
zh.idea: 借少量真实记录作工具，把其余数成块搬动，再做局部接排，最后归还工具记录。以下具体讲 WikiSort 的两内部缓冲机制：只给左有序排 A 的块贴标签，右排 B 保留真正块首。Grailsort 是相关实现，但调度和边界不能混用。
steps: 先形成相邻有序排 A、B。短排可插入排序：拿住下一项，把前面更大的项右移，再放进空位。大排逐轮接起来。一次大接排取约 √|A| 的块长，即块长与块数大致相等。
找两组不同键：一组能装一块作工作区，另一组有每个剩余 A 块一个标签。先找选中键的位置，再从后面往前旋转，将选中键聚到保留区，保持未选记录相对次序。保留区不参加滚动。
按 A 块原次序，用升序标签分别与块首交换。真正首值寄存在相应标签槽。最小剩余标签指出下一 A 块；读标签区的对应真首值才能决定它插在哪。B 块不贴标签。
把滚动区最左 A 块与下一个同长 B 块逐项交换，让 B 前进、A 后移；A 块允许暂乱序。若下一 A 真首值仍大于刚越过 B 块的末值，再滚一块 B。否则扫描剩余 A 标签，找最小标签块，把它换到滚动区最左。
在刚越过的 B 块内找第一个不小于 A 真首值的位置：比较中间值，若太小就找右半，否则找左半，直到得到插入点。旋转 B 的这个后缀与 A 块，让 A 放在此处，相等时 A 在前。交换标签与寄存真首值，把块首恢复。
下一 A 块落定后，前一 A 和夹在两块之间的 B 项可以排定。先把前一 A 逐项交换到工作区。比较工作区未用头和 B 未用头，把较小者与下一输出格交换，前进所选头和输出位置。相等先取 A。被挤走的借用记录仍存着，不能直接覆盖。一边空后，另一边余项顺序交换到位。
最后一 A 与剩余 B 同法处理。打乱的工作区键用插入排序复原；标签恢复后仍有序。用搜索和旋转把保留键送回主体，按抽取来源保持等值先后。不同键不够时，WikiSort 只保留一个标签区、加大块长以减少块数，局部用搜索加旋转；不足整块的首尾片段也另作旋转。
example: 标签 3 换真首 6，标签 4 换真首 11。A 暂为 [3,9][4,14]，标签区 [6,11]。滚过 [5,7]，因 6≤7，在 7 前插入第一 A 块并恢复真首，形成 [5][6,9][7]。
9<10，交换工作区 9 与输出格 2，局部 [6,7,8,9,10]，工作区回 [1,2]。10 已在正确格。最后一 A 与 B 输出 11、12、13、14、15、16。主体成为 5 到 16，归还 [1,2]、[3,4]，得到完整 1 到 16。小块用于展示；正式实现直接处理这种小数组。
zh.cost: 设 n 是项数。成熟实现每层工作 O(n)，约有 log₂n 层，通常和最坏 O(n log n)。一轮约 √n 个 A 块，反复扫描这些标签最多约 (√n)²=n 次；把 √n 个工作键插入重排也只需 O(n)。原地配置外部空间 O(1) 个机器字；借来的 O(√n) 项属于输入，不是新分配。可选外部缓冲改变空间。跳过已顺序正确的接排可使最好接近 O(n)。成熟实现稳定，前提是抽取、相等规则、归还都正确。
zh.why: 用块移动避免让单个左项反复跨越整排。省内存的代价是抽取、标签、恢复与边界管理，常数成本高，初学实现容易错。
zh.use: 需要稳定又不能分配完整副本时有价值。先手演示动作，生产时复用经过测试的代码。
zh.details: 标签只标明原块次序，不能用它代替真首值决定插入点。少键和不整块情况是完整算法所需规则，不是可任意省去的优化。

foundation: A block is a consecutive group of slots. Exchange equal-size blocks item by item, not just their fronts.
Workspace temporarily holds data. Here it is borrowed from the input, so its original records must return.
Distinct tags temporarily replace A-block fronts to show original block order. The real fronts are parked in the tag area. Tags and real front values answer different questions.
Rotation exchanges neighboring pieces while preserving internal order. Reverse each piece and then the whole: [7,8 | 5,6] becomes [8,7 | 5,6], then [8,7 | 6,5], then [5,6 | 7,8].
|A| counts items in A. The symbol √ means square root: √16=4 because 4×4=16.
en.idea: Borrow a few real records as tools, move the remainder in blocks, join neighboring ordered pieces, then return every borrowed record. The representative below uses WikiSort’s two internal buffers. Only left-run A blocks receive tags; right-run B blocks retain actual first values. Related Grailsort has different scheduling and boundary rules.
steps: First form neighboring ordered runs A and B. Tiny runs can use insertion: hold the next item, shift larger preceding items right, then fill the opening. Increase run sizes in successive joining rounds. For a large join, choose block length near √|A|.

Find distinct keys for two reserved groups: workspace large enough for one A block, and one tag per remaining A block. Identify selected keys, then collect them by rotations working backward from later selected groups. Unselected records retain their relative order. Reserved areas do not roll.

Exchange ascending tags with A-block first items in original order. Real first values remain in corresponding tag slots. The minimum remaining tag identifies the next original A block; read its corresponding real first value to decide insertion. B blocks receive no tags.

Exchange the leftmost rolling A block with the next equal-size B block. B moves left and A moves right; A blocks may become scrambled. Keep rolling while the next real A first value exceeds the last value of the B block crossed. Otherwise find the minimum-tag A block and exchange it into the leftmost rolling position.

Binary-search the preceding B block for its first value at least the real A first value. A smaller middle value eliminates the left half; otherwise retain the left half. Rotate that B suffix with A to insert A there. A goes before equal B values. Exchange its tag back with its real first value.

After the next A block lands, finish the previous A and intervening B items. Exchange that A block into workspace. Compare workspace and B heads; exchange the smaller head with the next output slot, then advance its source and the output. Choose A on ties. Displaced borrowed records remain safe. When one source ends, exchange the other remainder into place.

Finish the last A with remaining B. Insertion-sort scrambled workspace keys, then redistribute both reserved groups using searches and rotations with source-aware tie rules. Scarce keys require one tag buffer, larger blocks, and search-and-rotation local joins. Uneven edge pieces also need special rotations.
example: The whole input [1,2,3,4,6,9,11,14 | 5,7,8,10,12,13,15,16] is unordered although each half is ordered. Reserve [1,2] as workspace and [3,4] as tags. A=[6,9][11,14]; B=[5,7][8,10][12,13][15,16]. All sixteen items survive.
Tag A as [3,9][4,14], parking real fronts [6,11]. Roll past [5,7]. Since 6≤7, insert and restore the first A before 7: [5][6,9][7].
The next front 11 passes [8,10] and belongs before 12 in [12,13]. After restoration the body is [5][6,9][7,8,10][11,14][12,13,15,16]. Tags return to [3,4].

Exchange [6,9] into workspace [1,2]. Workspace becomes [6,9], local output [1,2,7,8,10]. Exchanging out 6 gives [6,2,7,8,10], workspace [1,9]. Choose B heads 7 and 8 next: [6,7,2,8,10], then [6,7,8,2,10].

Now 9<10. Exchange workspace 9 with output 2, obtaining [6,7,8,9,10] and restoring workspace [1,2]. Join the last pair into [11,12,13,14,15,16]. Return [1,2] and [3,4] to obtain 1 through 16. Real code directly handles tiny arrays; small blocks expose its tools.
en.cost: Let n count items. Established implementations keep each joining level to O(n), giving typical and worst O(n log n). Searching √n tags √n times costs O(n); insertion-sorting √n workspace keys also costs O(n). In-place configurations externally allocate O(1) machine words; borrowed O(√n) records remain inside the input. Optional external buffers change this. Ordered-input skipping can approach O(n). Established implementations are stable when extraction, ties, and restoration follow their rules.
en.why: Whole blocks avoid repeated long individual shifts. Extraction, tagging, restoration, and edges add considerable overhead.
en.use: Useful when stability must avoid a full second record array. Act out these operations, then use tested production code.
en.details: Tags describe original block order, not value-based insertion points. Restore every borrowed record. Scarce-key and uneven-block handling are necessary parts of the complete algorithm.

zh_alias: 快排；本节采用 Lomuto 单向扫描分区

foundation: 本节用从 0 开始的位置编号。lo、hi 分别是当前排的第一和最后位置，两端都属于这一排。
枢轴只是临时挑来作分界标准的数。这里挑最后一项；其他记录照旧保留。
分区不是完全排序，而是把“小于等于标准”的放一边，把“更大”的放另一边。交换两个格子时，两个值都保留。
a 是这排数的名字，a[i] 就是编号 i 的格子里那项；方括号是在指定位置，不是做乘法。
zh.idea: 从左到右看一次，把不大于末尾枢轴的数收集到前面。最后把枢轴夹到两组之间。这一项此时已经到正确位置；再对左右两组重复，所有位置就逐渐确定。
steps: 若范围少于两项，结束。保存末项的值 p，令 b=lo：b 指向前面已收集小项区之后的第一个位置；最开始小项区为空。
令扫描位置 j 从 lo 走到 hi−1，暂时不扫描枢轴格。若 a[j]≤p，交换 a[j] 与 a[b]，然后 b 加一。若 a[j]>p，不交换，只让 j 继续。
为什么可交换？b 到 j 之间已经看过的项都大于 p，把其中一项换到 j，并不会破坏小项区；j 自己等于 b 时自交换也无害。
扫描结束，把末尾枢轴与 a[b] 交换。b 前的项全≤p，b 后的项全>p，所以 b 上这个枢轴无需再参与排序。
对 [lo,b−1] 和 [b+1,hi] 分别重做这些动作。每次留下一个固定位置，范围变小，单项或空范围停止。可以用函数调用记住待做范围，也可自己用列表记录它们。
example: 看 j=2 的 3，3>2，留下。扫描结束，交换 b=1 上的 4 与末尾 2，成为 [1,2,3,4]。位置 1 的 2 固定，左组 [1]、右组 [3,4]。
左组单项停止。右组末项 p=4，扫描 3 时它≤4，只和自己交换；枢轴 4 最后也和自己交换，右组已排好。结果 [1,2,3,4]。这个例子刚好一次分区就形成全局顺序，通常左右组仍要继续处理。
zh.cost: 设 n 为记录数。一轮分区扫描整个当前范围，所以成本随范围长度增长。若每次分成大小接近的两组，约有 log₂n 层，最好 Θ(n log n)；随机打乱输入或随机选枢轴后期望 Θ(n log n)。每次只分出一项则要扫描 n、n−1、n−2…项，最坏 Θ(n²)。本规则全相等时每项都进左组，也会退化。通常调用栈 O(log n)，最坏 O(n)；每次只调用较小组、较大组用循环可把栈限在 O(log n)。不稳定。
zh.why: 扫描动作很简单，许多小项能直接前移。但末项若总是极值，大部分范围要反复扫描；相等项多也不利。自交换和记录移动有真实成本。
zh.use: 适合理解快排基本机制和核对分区逻辑。通用工程实现通常增加随机枢轴、三路处理或退化回退。
zh.details: 固定的是这次枢轴的一项，不是前面全部数。边界 b 两边再排时必须排除 b。若改成严格小于 p，等值分组会变，但单侧等值退化仍可能存在。

foundation: Positions here start at zero. lo and hi are the first and last positions of the current range, both included.
A pivot is a temporarily chosen comparison value. This version chooses the last item without removing it.
Partitioning separates values into groups; it does not order every item within those groups.
Notation a[i] means the item in slot i of the row named a. Brackets select a position; they do not mean multiplication.
en.idea: Scan from left to right and collect items no larger than the last-item pivot near the front. Then put the pivot between the two groups. That pivot item is finished. Repeat the operation on the two remaining groups.
steps: Stop for fewer than two items. Save the last value as p and set b=lo. Position b is the first slot after the collected small-item group, which initially contains nothing.
Scan j from lo through hi−1, leaving the pivot slot untouched. If a[j]≤p, exchange a[j] with a[b], then increase b. Otherwise leave it and continue scanning.

Why is the exchange safe? Already scanned items from b to just before j are larger than p. Moving one of them to j leaves the small-item group intact. When b=j, exchanging a slot with itself changes nothing.
After the scan, exchange a[b] with the pivot at hi. Everything before b is at most p; everything after b is larger. The pivot at b has its final position.
Apply these instructions separately to [lo,b−1] and [b+1,hi]. Exclude b. Empty ranges and singletons stop. Calls can remember unfinished ranges, or an explicit list can do that job.
example: Use [4,1,3,2], with p=2 and b=0. Scan 4: it is larger, so leave it. Scan 1: exchange it with slot b, producing [1,4,3,2], then set b=1.
Scan 3: it is larger than 2, so leave it. Exchange the final pivot 2 with slot 1 containing 4. The row becomes [1,2,3,4]. Pivot 2 is fixed; unfinished ranges are [1] and [3,4].

The singleton stops. In [3,4], pivot 4 admits 3 into the small group through a self-exchange, and the final pivot exchange also changes nothing. All items are ordered. This lucky trace becomes globally ordered early; other partitions usually leave more work within both groups.
en.cost: Let n count records. A partition scans its entire range. Roughly equal splits give about log₂n levels and best Θ(n log n) time. Random input or randomized pivots give expected Θ(n log n). Repeated one-item splits scan n+(n−1)+… items, giving worst Θ(n²). All-equal input also degenerates with this ≤ rule. Stack space is usually O(log n), worst O(n), or always O(log n) when only the smaller side recurses. The algorithm is unstable.
en.why: Simple scans and exchanges are cheap, but repeatedly choosing an extreme pivot rescans almost the whole input. Equal values need additional care.
en.use: A clear introduction to quicksort partitioning. General-purpose versions usually add pivot sampling, equal-key grouping, or a fallback.
en.details: Only the pivot item is final, not every item before it. Use this scheme’s recursion boundaries. Changing ≤ to < changes equal-key placement without automatically removing its bad equal-key case.

zh_alias: Hoare 原始分区；双向扫描快排变体
en_alias: Original Hoare partition scheme; two-pointer quicksort variant

foundation: 这里位置从 0 编号。lo、hi 都包括在当前范围内；靠左中点就是 (lo+hi) 除以 2 后去掉小数部分。
两个指针是两个位置编号：一个向右找，一个向左找；它们不会自动移动，步骤要明确规定每次移多少。
枢轴只是一份保存的数值。原来存它的记录可以被交换到别处，但比较标准不变。
a 是这排数的名字，a[i] 就是编号 i 的格子里那项；方括号是在指定位置，不是做乘法。
zh.idea: 从两头找“站错边”的数：左边找不小于枢轴的，右边找不大于枢轴的，把这一对交换。扫描碰到或越过时，便得到能分别继续排的两组。返回的位置只是分界；不能当成枢轴已固定的位置。
steps: 范围少于两项就停止。取下中点 floor((lo+hi)/2) 的值为 p；floor 的意思是向下取整。设 i=lo−1、j=hi+1，先站在范围外。不要改用上中点；两项有序时可能分出没有缩小的范围。

先让 i 加一，再只要 a[i]

p 就继续减一；遇到≤p 的项停下。
若 i≥j，不交换，返回 j。左范围 [lo,j] 的项都≤p，右范围 [j+1,hi] 的项都≥p。这里允许两组都有等值项。
若 i<j，交换两处。较小或相等项去了左边，较大或相等项去了右边；回到扫描步骤，两指针都先移动一次，避免在等值处永远打转。
分别排包含 j 的 [lo,j] 与 [j+1,hi]，重复同样规则。下中点与上述扫描使两个子范围比原范围小；零项或一项停止。不要丢掉分界 j，它没有被保证固定。
example: [4,1,3,2]，lo=0、hi=3，下中点索引 1 的值是 p=1。i 从 −1 前进一步，在 4 停；j 从 4 后退，跳过 2、3，在位置 1 的 1 停。
交换 4、1，成为 [1,4,3,2]。下一轮 i 前移到位置 1 的 4；j 后移到位置 0 的 1。i≥j，返回 j=0。两组为 [1]、[4,3,2]。
右组边界 1..3，下中点 2 的值 p=3。左扫描停 4、右扫描停 2，交换成为 [1,2,3,4]。再移动后都停在位置 2 的 3，返回分界 2，留下 [2,3]、[4]。
[2,3] 的下中点是 2；两扫描相遇在它的左位置，分成 [2]、[3]。全体停止，结果 [1,2,3,4]。本例某些分界刚好也是最终位置，但算法没有这个承诺。
zh.cost: 设 n 是项数。每次两头扫描总共经过当前范围的项；一项不会在同一轮被无限追看。均衡分区最好 Θ(n log n)，随机输入或恰当随机枢轴下期望 Θ(n log n)，坏分区最坏 Θ(n²)。全等时两指针不断对称前进，仍分成近半两组，时间 Θ(n log n)，没有三路快排的一轮结束优势。通常栈 O(log n)，最坏 O(n)；较小侧调用、大侧循环可把栈限制到 O(log n)。不稳定。
zh.why: 一个交换同时纠正两边的一项，通常比只从一边收集少一些交换。不过次数少不代表任何数据上都快；分区是否均衡仍然关键。
zh.use: 常用作高效数组快排的分区方式，前提是仔细配合中点选择、等值停止和子范围边界。
zh.details: 有的教材把最后放回枢轴的双向扫描也称 Hoare 风格。那个版本会固定一项，边界不同。本节使用原始返回分界方案，必须保留 j 在左子范围。

foundation: Use zero-based positions and inclusive endpoints lo and hi. The lower middle position is floor((lo+hi)/2); floor discards the fractional part.
A scanning pointer is a remembered position. Moving it means explicitly adding or subtracting one.
Save the pivot value separately. Its original record may move, but the saved comparison value does not.
en.idea: Look inward for items on the wrong side: the left scan stops on a value at least the pivot, and the right scan stops on one at most the pivot. Exchange the pair. When the scans meet or cross, split at their boundary. This boundary does not certify a final pivot position.
steps: Stop at fewer than two items. Save the lower-middle value as p. Set i=lo−1 and j=hi+1, just outside the range. Do not substitute the upper middle: a two-item ordered range can then fail to shrink.
Advance i once, then keep advancing while its value is smaller than p. Retreat j once, then keep retreating while its value is larger than p. Stop on equal values as well as misplaced ones.
If i≥j, return j without exchanging. Values in [lo,j] are at most p, and values in [j+1,hi] are at least p. Equal values may appear on both sides.
Otherwise exchange the stopped values and repeat the scans. Each scan starts with its compulsory movement, so equal values cannot trap it at the same positions forever.
Sort [lo,j] and [j+1,hi] using these instructions. Include j in the left range. The lower-middle choice and scan rules make both subranges smaller. Stop at empty ranges and singletons.
example: For [4,1,3,2], bounds are 0..3. The lower-middle position 1 gives p=1. The left scan stops at 4. The right scan passes 2 and 3, then stops at 1.
Exchange them to get [1,4,3,2]. Next, i moves to position 1 and j to position 0. They cross. Return boundary 0 and handle [1] and [4,3,2].

For the right range, lower-middle value 3 is the pivot. Exchange stopped values 4 and 2: [1,2,3,4]. The next scans meet at position 2 containing 3, so return boundary 2. The unfinished groups are [2,3] and [4].
The lower-middle pivot 2 splits [2,3] into singletons. The result is [1,2,3,4]. A boundary happened to be final here; do not depend on that coincidence.
en.cost: Let n be the record count. A partition scans across its range once from two directions. Balanced distinct-key splits give best Θ(n log n); suitable randomization gives expected Θ(n log n). Bad splits allow worst Θ(n²). All-equal input splits near the middle but still requires Θ(n log n), rather than finishing in one pass. Stack space is typically O(log n), worst O(n), or O(log n) with smaller-side recursion. The method is unstable.
en.why: An exchange corrects one item on each side. Fewer exchanges can help, but balanced subproblems remain essential.
en.use: A common array-quicksort mechanism when scan limits and recursive bounds are carefully implemented.
en.details: Some two-way schemes finally move the pivot and are called Hoare-style. Their bounds differ. This lesson uses the original boundary-returning scheme: never exclude j as if it were a final pivot.

rows.en: Save middle value p=1; stop at 4 and 1

zh_alias: 三向快排；肥枢轴快排；分区使用荷兰国旗思路

foundation: 把一排分成三种是按值与标准比较：小于、等于、大于。等于不是删除重复数；每条等值记录都要留下。
三个位置把数组分成四区：已知小、已知等、尚未检查、已知大。只有尚未检查区需要继续判断。
交换之后，当前位置换进来的数可能从未检查过，所以不能一律向前走。
a 是这排数的名字，a[i] 就是编号 i 的格子里那项；方括号是在指定位置，不是做乘法。
zh.idea: 普通快排对许多等值项可能反复做无用分区。三路快排一次把所有等于枢轴的项集中到中间，中间不用再排，只处理较小和较大两边。
steps: 选一个范围内的值保存为 p。位置从 0 编号，设 lt=lo、i=lo、gt=hi。lo..lt−1 是已知小项；lt..i−1 是等值项；i..gt 尚未检查；gt+1..hi 是已知大项。开始前三个已知区都为空。
只在 i≤gt 时判断 a[i]。若 a[i]<p，交换 a[i] 与 a[lt]，然后 lt、i 各加一。小项进了左区；若换进的是一个等值项，它已经检查过，可以同时前进。
若 a[i]=p，只让 i 加一，中间等值区扩大一项，保留这条记录。
若 a[i]>p，交换 a[i] 与 a[gt]，gt 减一，但 i 不前进。大项已进右区；从右边换来的项还不知道大小，必须再检查一次。
当 i>gt，未知区已经空了。只重排 lo..lt−1 与 gt+1..hi；中间 lt..gt 的每项都等于 p，作为整体完成。子范围少于两项时结束。
example: 位置 2 的 3 相等，i 到 3。2<3，交换位置 3 与 lt=1，变 [1,2,3,3,3]；lt=2、i=4。最后一项相等，i 到 5，未知区空了。
小组 [1,2] 继续排，选 1 作标准。1 相等；2>1，交换自己并缩小右界，留下单项 [2]。最终 [1,2,3,3,3]，三个 3 全保留。
为看清“不前进”：局部 [2,3,1] 取 p=2，看到中间 3 就和右端 1 交换成 [2,1,3]；仍检查同一中间位置的新 1，把它换到左边，得到 [1,2,3]。若直接跳过，就漏查了 1。
zh.cost: 设 n 是项数。一轮中每项进入某个已知区，扫描 Θ(n)。全部相等时一轮就完成，最好 Θ(n)。不同键、随机枢轴或随机输入通常期望 Θ(n log n)；枢轴连续极偏时最坏 Θ(n²)。通常栈 O(log n)，最坏 O(n)，采用较小侧调用可把栈限制 O(log n)。交换能跨过等值记录，因此不稳定；中间值相同不等于原身份顺序不变。
zh.why: 大量重复值只需判断一次，不再把等值区拆下去。不同键居多时仍是快排，选坏枢轴依然有反复扫描成本。
zh.use: 重复键多的统计、类别、评分数据很适合；也常作字符串按单个字符分组的基础。
zh.details: 不要在大于分支同时增加 i。三个已知区的边界每一步都要匹配；把等值区遗漏或输出一次，都会丢掉重复记录。

foundation: Three groups mean smaller than, equal to, and larger than a chosen value. Equal records are retained individually.
Three positions divide the row into known-small, known-equal, unchecked, and known-large regions. Only the unchecked region needs decisions.
After an exchange, an incoming item may be unchecked. Advancing immediately can skip it.
Notation a[i] means the item in slot i of the row named a. Brackets select a position; they do not mean multiplication.
en.idea: Collect all pivot-equal items in the middle during one scan. They need no further sorting by this key. Continue only on smaller and larger groups, avoiding repeated work on duplicates.
steps: Save pivot value p. With zero-based inclusive bounds, set lt=lo, i=lo, gt=hi. The regions are lo..lt−1 small, lt..i−1 equal, i..gt unchecked, and gt+1..hi large. Initially only the unchecked region exists.
While i≤gt, inspect a[i]. If it is smaller than p, exchange it with a[lt], then advance both lt and i. The small region grows. Any equal item displaced from its boundary was already checked.
If it equals p, advance i only. This enlarges the equal region without removing the record.
If it is larger, exchange it with a[gt] and decrease gt. Keep i unchanged: the incoming right-side item still needs checking.
When i>gt, nothing remains unchecked. Sort only the small and large ranges with these same instructions. The equal range lt..gt is finished. Empty and singleton ranges stop.
example: For [3,1,3,2,3], take p=3. The first 3 advances i to 1. The 1 is small, so exchange positions 1 and 0: [1,3,3,2,3], with lt=1 and i=2.
The next 3 advances i to 3. Exchange 2 with the equal-region boundary at lt=1: [1,2,3,3,3], with lt=2 and i=4. The last 3 advances i beyond gt. All three 3s remain.
Sort [1,2] separately using pivot 1. The 1 is equal; the 2 moves into the large region through a self-exchange. Its singleton needs no work. Result: [1,2,3,3,3].

To see why a large-item exchange does not advance i, take [2,3,1] with p=2. Exchange middle 3 with last 1: [2,1,3]. Check the new middle 1 again and move it left, obtaining [1,2,3]. Skipping that check would miss the 1.
en.cost: Let n count items. Each step shrinks the unchecked region, so one partition costs Θ(n). All-equal input finishes in that pass: best Θ(n). Random distinct keys or randomized pivots give expected Θ(n log n); extreme splits allow worst Θ(n²). Stack is typically O(log n), worst O(n), or O(log n) with smaller-side recursion. The method is unstable because distant exchanges can reorder equal records.
en.why: Duplicates leave further work immediately. With mostly different keys, the method retains quicksort’s dependence on pivot quality.
en.use: Useful for categories, scores, and other repeated keys; also the foundation of character-based string partitioning.
en.details: Do not advance i in the larger-than branch. Keep all equal records rather than replacing the group by one representative. An equal-value group need not preserve the original order of its record identities.

sources.title: Wild: Quicksort with many equal keys

rows.zh: 2 小于 3；中段三个 3 已完成

zh_alias: 双轴快排；Yaroslavskiy 风格双枢轴分区

foundation: 两个枢轴是两个保存的标准值 p≤q。它们把值分成“小于 p”“从 p 到 q”“大于 q”三段。
扫描区只是一段还没判断的格子；前后都可留已经分类的记录，不需要立刻让它们内部有序。
末尾换来一个新数时要重新判断，这一点和三路分区相同。
a 是这排数的名字，a[i] 就是编号 i 的格子里那项；方括号是在指定位置，不是做乘法。
zh.idea: 把两个标准放在两端，扫描中间。很小的向左收集，很大的向右收集，其余留在中段。最后把两个标准放到各自边界，再分别排三段。本节展开一个简单可执行的教学分区；成熟 Yaroslavskiy 实现会用更精细的扫描和优化。
steps: 少于两项停止。比较两端，若左大右小就交换，保存左值 p、右值 q。设 lt=lo+1、gt=hi−1、i=lt；两端暂不参与扫描。
当 i≤gt，若 a[i]<p，和 a[lt] 交换，lt、i 各加一。若 p≤a[i]≤q，只让 i 加一，这项属中段。
若 a[i]>q，和 a[gt] 交换，再把 gt 减一。暂不移动 i，回头判断换来的项；它可能小于 p、位于中段或仍大于 q。
未知区空后，lt 减一、gt 加一。交换左端枢轴与 a[lt]，交换右端枢轴与 a[gt]。两个枢轴夹住已分类的三段。
分别处理 lo..lt−1、lt+1..gt−1、gt+1..hi，不再含这两项。若 p=q，中段全相等，可整段跳过。若 p≠q，中段只是落在两值之间，仍要排。单项和空段停止。
example: 看到 5>4，交换位置 2 与 3，成为 [3,1,2,5,4]，gt=2。i 仍为 2，重新看到 2<3，和 lt 的自己交换，lt=i=3。i>gt，未知区空。
lt 减到 2，左枢轴 3 与位置 2 的 2 交换，得到 [2,1,3,5,4]。gt 加到 3，右枢轴 4 与位置 3 的 5 交换，得到 [2,1,3,4,5]。
枢轴 3、4 固定；左段 [2,1] 用端点比较换成 [1,2]，中段为空，右段 [5] 单项。完成 [1,2,3,4,5]。
zh.cost: 设 n 是项数。一轮仍扫描当前范围，但一项可能先与 p 再与 q 比较，并有搬动。不同键、良好采样或随机输入通常期望 O(n log n)，最坏 O(n²)；把两端直接作枢轴没有普遍速度保证。本教学版若两标准相同就跳过中段，全等最好 Θ(n)。通常栈 O(log n)，未经控制最坏 O(n)。不稳定。各具体双枢轴实现的精确比较数不同，不能混成一个结论。
zh.why: 一轮可留下三块待做范围，可能减少后续层数，却增加一轮内部判断和交换。是否更快还受采样、重复值、缓存和机器影响。
zh.use: 适合研究多标准分区，以及了解一些语言库为什么采用双枢轴快排。
zh.details: 千万不要因为中段在 p 与 q 之间就认为中段已经有序。例如 [2,7,3,8] 的中间两项仍可能要再排。这里的步骤不声称逐行复制某个语言运行库的实现。

foundation: Two pivots are saved values p≤q. They define values below p, between p and q inclusive, and above q.
A classified region is not necessarily internally ordered. It only satisfies its value limits.
After exchanging with the unchecked right end, inspect the incoming item before moving on.
Notation a[i] means the item in slot i of the row named a. Brackets select a position; they do not mean multiplication.
en.idea: Place comparison values at both ends, classify the interior, then move the pivots to the group boundaries. Continue on the three remaining regions. This lesson uses a simple executable teaching partition; production Yaroslavskiy implementations refine its scans and pivot selection.
steps: Stop for fewer than two items. Compare the endpoints and exchange them if needed. Save their values as p and q. Set lt=lo+1, gt=hi−1, and i=lt, leaving both endpoint pivots outside the scan.
While i≤gt, a value below p exchanges with a[lt]; advance lt and i. A value between p and q remains in the middle; advance i only.
A value above q exchanges with a[gt]; decrease gt but retain i. Inspect the incoming item again. It may belong to any of the three groups.
When no unchecked items remain, decrease lt and increase gt. Exchange the left pivot into lt and the right pivot into gt. Their two positions are now finished.

Sort lo..lt−1, lt+1..gt−1, and gt+1..hi separately. If p=q, the entire middle equals that value and can be skipped. If p differs from q, the middle still needs sorting. Empty ranges and singletons stop.
example: Use [4,1,5,2,3]. Exchange endpoints to get [3,1,5,2,4], so p=3 and q=4. Start lt=i=1 and gt=3. The 1 is small; a self-exchange advances lt and i to 2.
The 5 exceeds q. Exchange positions 2 and 3: [3,1,2,5,4], with gt=2. Keep i=2 and inspect incoming 2. It is below p, so its self-exchange advances lt and i to 3.
The scan ends. Decrease lt to 2 and exchange pivot 3 with value 2: [2,1,3,5,4]. Increase gt to 3 and exchange pivot 4 with value 5: [2,1,3,4,5].
The pivots are fixed. Sort left range [2,1] by exchanging its endpoints. The middle is empty and the right [5] stops. Result: [1,2,3,4,5].
en.cost: Let n count records. Each partition scans its range, but an item may need both pivot comparisons and exchanges. Suitable sampling or random distinct input commonly gives expected O(n log n). Worst time is O(n²); endpoint pivots alone do not prevent bad splits. With the stated equal-pivot shortcut, all-equal input gives best Θ(n). Stack is typically O(log n), worst O(n) without control. The method is unstable. Different dual-pivot implementations have different exact comparison counts.
en.why: Three subproblems can reduce later levels, but classification costs more within each level. Sampling, equal values, cache behavior, and hardware decide whether that trade pays.
en.use: Useful for understanding multi-pivot partitioning and some standard-library sorting choices.
en.details: The middle is range-limited, not ordered. Continue sorting it unless p=q. These teaching steps do not claim to reproduce a particular runtime library line for line.

zh_alias: Introspective sort；快速排序与堆排序的混合

foundation: 快排先按一个标准值分左右，再分别处理两边。若每次只能分出一项，几乎整排会被扫描很多遍。
预算在这里是一个整数计数器，记录同一条拆分路径还允许继续分区多少次，不是时间测量，也不是全局所有分区共用一个钱包。
插入动作是拿住下一项、把前面更大的项右移、放进空位。最大堆则是把每个父项摆得不小于孩子，让第一项一定最大。
zh.idea: 先走通常很快的快排路线，同时数拆分层数。层数太深说明这一条路不顺，就对那一块改用最坏工作受控的堆排序；非常小的块直接插入。它不是一种神秘的新搬动，而是按明确条件选择已有的三组动作。
steps: 空输入或只有一项时直接结束，不计算预算。其余输入有 n 项时，常把预算设为 2floor(log₂n)。具体可从整数 n 开始，每次除以二去掉小数部分，直到只剩一，数做了几次，再乘二。16→8→4→2→1 有四次，预算八；10→5→2→1 有三次，预算六。选固定小范围阈值。
处理范围时，若它很小，做插入：从第二项起保存 x，向左看，只要前项>x 就把前项右移，最后把 x 写入空位，直到整块有序。若不是小范围且预算为零，跳到堆方法。
预算还有时，挑枢轴。常取第一、中间、最后三个值的中位数：几次比较排出这三值，取中间值，不是把所有数求平均。把它移到末端，扫描其余项；用前部边界收集≤枢轴的数，最后把枢轴交换到边界，留下两边未排块。这里展开一种可用分区，具体库可用其他正确分区。
预算减一，两个子块各获得这个减一后的数。分别继续同样决策；处理一个子块不会另行消耗另一个子块的余额。为省栈，可先调用较小子块，较大子块用循环继续。
后备堆只处理当前未完成块。把块内编号从 0 看起，i 的孩子为 2i+1、2i+2。从最后父项往前，比较孩子选较大的；父比它小就交换并沿新位置往下，直到父足够大或无孩子。
堆根成为最大值后，交换根与本块最后活跃项，缩小活跃范围，再让换入的根沿较大孩子向下找位置。反复直到只余一项。这个块有序后就返回，绝不能重排其他已经确定的范围。
example: 为看清切换，另用同样输入，但故意把预算设为一、关闭小数组捷径。选末项 2 为标准。4>2 留下；1≤2，与前部 4 换位，成 [1,4,3,2]；3>2 留下。再交换标准与 4，成 [1,2,3,4]。
枢轴 2 固定，左块 [1] 已完；右块 [3,4] 继承余额零，改建堆。父 3 比孩子 4 小，交换为 [1,2,4,3]，这里只改右块。
把右块根 4 与它的末项 3 交换，得 [1,2,3,4]；余下一项停止。这是为展示机制而选的控制设置，不是普通库在四项上真的会走的路线。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数。每层分区合计最多扫描 n 项，路径预算只有 O(log n) 层，所以分区总量 O(n log n)。后备块互不重叠，各自堆排的工作加起来也不超过 O(n log n)。通常 Θ(n log n)，最坏 O(n log n)；基础非自适应版最好也约 Θ(n log n)，小块插入不会改变大输入的这个量级。通常实现栈 O(log n)，交换临时空间 O(1)。不稳定。
zh.why: 正常数据保留快排的连续扫描；坏分区不能无限延续。额外只多预算判断，坏情况下堆虽然常数成本大些，却把总工作封住。
zh.use: 适合通用数组排序，尤其不能容忍特殊输入导致平方级工作的情况。
zh.details: 预算按当前拆分路径递减，不是按完成了多少交换递减。只有当前未完成范围切换到堆。某些实现最后用一次插入扫描收尾，也要先保证未完成小块的大小受到控制。

foundation: Quicksort separates a range around a reference value, then works on both sides. One-item splits can repeatedly rescan nearly the whole row.
A depth budget is an integer counter for one chain of subdivisions. It is not a timer or one shared budget spent by every branch.
Insertion holds the next item, shifts larger preceding items right, and fills the opening. A maximum heap puts each parent above smaller children so its first item is largest.
en.idea: Begin with quicksort. If one chain of partitions becomes too deep, switch that unfinished range to heapsort. Use insertion for tiny ranges. Introsort chooses among these familiar actions using explicit size and budget tests.
steps: Stop immediately for empty or singleton input, without computing a budget. For other inputs of n items, a common starting budget is 2floor(log₂n). Compute it by repeatedly integer-dividing n by two until one remains, counting the steps and doubling the count. 16→8→4→2→1 gives budget eight; 10→5→2→1 gives six. Choose a fixed tiny-range threshold.

At a tiny range, insert its items: starting with the second, hold x, move preceding values larger than x one slot right, then write x into the opening. Repeat to the end. Otherwise, if the budget is zero, use the heap steps below.

With budget left, choose a pivot. A common sample is the first, middle, and last values: compare them to find the middle-valued one, not their arithmetic average. One valid teaching partition moves it to the end, scans other items, exchanges values at most the pivot into a growing front region, and finally exchanges the pivot into that region’s boundary.

Subtract one from the budget. Both unfinished sides receive that reduced value. Processing one branch does not spend the other branch’s allowance. Calling the smaller side and looping over the larger side limits stack use.

The fallback heap applies only to the current range. Use local positions starting at zero, with children 2i+1 and 2i+2. Starting with the last parent and working backward, select its larger child; exchange if the parent is smaller, and continue downward. Stop at a sufficiently large parent or a childless position.

The heap root is now largest. Exchange it with the last active item of this range, shrink the active part, and sink the replacement root by the same larger-child rule. Repeat until one item remains, then return to the surrounding task.
example: A practical implementation usually inserts [4,1,3,2] directly. Insert 1 by shifting 4: [1,4,3,2]. Insert 3 by shifting 4: [1,3,4,2]. Insert 2 by shifting 4 and 3: [1,2,3,4].

To expose the fallback separately, use the same input with an artificial budget of one and disable the tiny-range shortcut. Pivot 2 admits 1 into the front by exchanging it with 4: [1,4,3,2]. The 3 stays larger. Put pivot 2 into its boundary slot: [1,2,3,4].
Left singleton [1] stops. Right range [3,4] inherits budget zero. Its heap construction exchanges parent 3 and child 4, giving [1,2,4,3]. Other ranges remain untouched.
Exchange that heap’s root 4 with its last 3: [1,2,3,4]. The remaining heap is a singleton. These artificial settings illustrate switching, not normal four-item library behavior.
en.cost: Let n count records. Partition ranges at one depth contain at most n items in total. Only O(log n) depths are allowed, so partition work is O(n log n). Fallback ranges do not overlap, and their combined heap work is also O(n log n). Typical time is Θ(n log n), worst O(n log n). Basic nonadaptive versions also have about Θ(n log n) best time. Standard control uses O(log n) stack space and O(1) exchange storage. It is unstable.
en.why: Ordinary cases keep quicksort’s fast scans. Difficult cases cannot continue bad partitions indefinitely; the heap supplies a dependable upper bound.
en.use: A general-purpose choice when unusual input must not trigger quadratic work.
en.details: The allowance follows partition depth, not swap count. Heap-sort only the unfinished current range. Versions that finish with one insertion sweep must still keep unfinished small pieces bounded in size.

foundation: 先记住三种小动作：按枢轴扫描分左右；拿住一项向前插入；让最大值沿父子规则升到堆根、再送尾部。这里是把这些动作配上观察和切换条件。
“模式”指输入已有规律，例如有序、逆序或周期排列。这些规律可能让某种选枢轴方式反复选坏标准。打破模式只交换少数位置，不生成或删除记录。
“有限尝试”是给插入搬动规定一个小上限；超过就停这条捷径，继续正常排序。试失败之后的数据可以变了，但所有记录必须还在。
zh.idea: pdqsort 一边快排，一边问两个具体问题：这次分区是否很偏？这一块是不是其实容易排？容易的用短插入结束，偏得厉害的先打乱少量位置，坏分区累计太多就堆排。还有专门等值处理，避免把重复项反复拆下去。
steps: 小范围直接插入：从第二项拿住 x，前面>x 的项逐格右移，x 填到停止处。大范围从第一、中间、末尾等小样本选中间值；更大范围可用多个三项样本的中间值再取中间值。这只挑标准，不是完成排序。
一种普通分区把枢轴暂放左端 lo 并保存其值 p，i=lo+1、j=hi。只在 i≤j 时扫描：左侧遇值
记录内部错边交换是否发生；挑样本、最后放枢轴的交换不等同于这个信号。如果分区不太偏且没有内部交换，分别尝试有限插入。每次向左挪 x 时累计挪了多少格；在小上限内排完就结束这块，超过就放好拿住的记录后退出尝试，继续分区。
如果某一侧少于当前范围约八分之一，就记为坏分区。交换大侧一些预先指定的远处分布位置，让后续样本不再看到同样布局；坏分区预算减一，初值与 log₂n 成正比，花完就堆排当前块。交换不能保证立刻均衡，真正最坏保护来自预算和堆后备。
还有一个有条件的等值捷径：若前一次分区已知这一块所有值≥左邻旧枢轴，而新枢轴恰等于旧值，就扫描把等值放前、严格更大者放后，等值区无需再排。没有那条已知下界时，不能擅自忽略较小值。
堆后备把当前块按父 i、孩子 2i+1/2i+2 看待。从末父向前，挑大孩子，父较小时交換并继续下沉。根成为最大后与活跃末项交换、缩小、继续下沉，直到一项。小范围插入、等值区完成和预算规则共同保证终止。
可选分支少的分区先把左侧错边位置收进小编号缓冲，右侧错边位置收进另一缓冲，再按配对交换。缓冲存的是“哪格错了”，不是额外输出记录；其容量固定。
example: 作者实现对 [4,1,3,2] 走小范围插入：插 1 得 [1,4,3,2]，插 3 得 [1,3,4,2]，插 2 时移 4、3，得 [1,2,3,4]。这条真实小例没有调用大范围模式逻辑。
单看容易分区信号：局部有序 [1,2,3,4,5] 选标准 3，把它暂放左端，成为 [3,2,1,4,5]。两头扫描在中间交叉，未交换内部错边对；枢轴回边界后变回 [1,2 | 3 | 4,5]。两边插入检查都不用移较大项，可快速确认。
单看坏分区信号：一块十六项若标准最小，左边零项、右边十五项，属于坏分区。预算减一，再交换右边若干样本位置；若随后仍不断出现这种分割，余额用完就只堆排余块。固定位置的具体选择是作者实现策略，不能由这个说明猜出一套必定最快的置换。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数。容易且被识别的输入可只扫描和短检查，最好 O(n)。一般 O(n log n)。每次坏分区减少预算，大幅未缩小的范围不能无限重复；堆后备使最坏 O(n log n)。通常作者实现栈 O(log n)，固定容量编号缓冲额外 O(1) 个机器字。不稳定。阈值与固定交换位置影响常数，不改变后备的总工作保护。
zh.why: 不盲目把容易排的块继续拆，也不任由坏模式反复耗时。额外的试探、采样和缓冲有成本，比较本身昂贵时，减少条件分支未必更划算。
zh.use: 高效通用数组排序，且不要求等值记录保持先后时。适合了解实际库如何把多个小优化组织成明确控制流程。
zh.details: 有限插入失败后仍须把拿住的记录放回；不能直接返回并丢掉它。原作者完整实现还包含防越界哨兵、采样布局等工程细节，生产应复用其代码。

foundation: Keep three actions in mind: partition around a value, insert a held item by shifting larger predecessors, and extract a heap maximum to the end. pdqsort combines them with observations and switching rules.

An input pattern is an existing arrangement such as ascending, descending, or periodic order. Some pivot policies repeatedly choose poorly on a pattern. Exchanging a few positions disturbs it without changing the records.
A limited insertion attempt has a small movement allowance. If it fails, all held records must be returned before normal sorting continues.
en.idea: While quicksorting, ask whether a split is badly uneven and whether a region already looks easy. Finish easy regions with a short insertion attempt; disturb recurring bad patterns; fall back to heapsort after too many bad splits. Conditional equal-key filtering avoids repeatedly processing duplicates.
steps: Use insertion on small ranges: hold the next x, shift larger predecessors right, then fill the opening. For larger ranges choose a middle-valued sample item. Large samples may take medians of three groups and then their median; this selects a pivot rather than sorting the row.

One ordinary partition temporarily places saved pivot p at left endpoint lo. Set i=lo+1 and j=hi. While i≤j, advance i over values below p and retreat j over values at least p, checking i≤j before reading. If they have not crossed, exchange the misplaced pair, advance i, and retreat j. After crossing, exchange the pivot with position j, then continue on either side. The observation records internal pair exchanges, not sample rearrangement or final pivot placement. Author code refines the bounds and offers a branchless form.

Record whether internal misplaced-pair exchanges occurred. Sample rearrangement and final pivot placement are different from that signal. If the split is reasonably balanced and no internal exchanges occurred, try insertion on the sides with a small total movement allowance. Count how many positions held items move. Finish if the attempt completes; otherwise return the held item safely and resume partitioning.

A side below roughly one eighth of the range marks a bad partition. Exchange a few specified, separated positions in the larger side to disturb repeated sampling patterns. Reduce a bad-partition allowance initially proportional to log₂n. On exhaustion, heap-sort this unfinished range. Pattern disturbance alone is not a guarantee; the allowance and fallback supply it.

Equal filtering needs prior information. If an earlier partition established that every value here is at least the preceding pivot, and the new pivot equals that value, separate equals from strictly larger items. Leave all equal records in the completed front and continue only on larger ones. Without that lower-bound information, smaller values cannot be ignored.

For fallback, use local heap positions: i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2. Work backward from the last parent, selecting its larger child and exchanging downward while the parent is smaller. Exchange the resulting maximum root to the active end, shrink, and sink again until one item remains.

An optional branchless partition records misplaced left positions in one fixed-size buffer and misplaced right positions in another, then exchanges matched pairs. These buffers hold locations, not additional output records.
example: The author implementation inserts tiny input [4,1,3,2]: insert 1 to get [1,4,3,2], then 3 to get [1,3,4,2], then 2 by shifting 4 and 3 to obtain [1,2,3,4]. Large-range pattern logic is not used.

Separately inspect an easy partition of ordered [1,2,3,4,5]. Temporarily move pivot 3 left: [3,2,1,4,5]. The scans cross without exchanging internal misplaced pairs. Final pivot placement restores [1,2 | 3 | 4,5]. Limited insertion on both sides confirms order without shifts.

For a bad-split example, a sixteen-item range whose pivot is its smallest value leaves zero items left and fifteen right. Spend one allowance and disturb specified positions on the large side. Continued failures eventually send the unfinished range to heapsort. Exact disturbance positions belong to the author’s implementation.
en.cost: Let n count records. Recognized easy patterns can take O(n) scans and short checks. Typical time is O(n log n). Repeated severely unbalanced splits spend the allowance; heapsort then bounds remaining work, giving worst O(n log n). Author implementations use O(log n) stack space and optional O(1) fixed buffer space. The method is unstable. Thresholds and disturbance choices affect constants.
en.why: Easy regions stop early, while difficult patterns cannot consume unlimited partition work. Sampling and trial checks add overhead, and branchless handling mainly helps cheap comparisons.
en.use: A fast general-purpose array sort when stability is unnecessary; also a useful example of explicit control around familiar sorting actions.
en.details: A failed trial must preserve every record. Production code also needs precise sample layouts, bounds, and sentinel handling; reuse the tested author implementation rather than treating this explanation as its complete source code.

en_alias: Sample sort; multiway sampled partitioning family

foundation: 桶是一组临时收集的记录；进桶不等于桶内有序。桶按数值范围排序，因此前桶所有值≤后桶所有值。
样本是从原输入选出少量值的副本，用来决定界限。原记录仍要正常分类，样本副本不能额外加到输出。
有多个升序界限时，可以比较中间界限、缩小候选范围，避免每次从第一个界限逐个试。
zh.idea: 用小样本猜出几个能把数据分得较均匀的界限，把所有记录放进相应范围桶，分别排桶，再按桶次序接起来。它用值比较找桶，不要求键是能直接当编号的整数。
steps: 确定桶数 b，抽取比 b 多一些的样本。把样本排好，例如按插入动作把下一值插进已排前部。再从排好样本的约等间隔位置取 b−1 个界限；样本多一些通常更不易选偏，但没有一次必定均匀的承诺。
明确每个界限的归属，例如等于界限进左边桶。对每条记录用界限比较找到唯一桶。比较中间界限后，一次可以排除一半候选桶；最终得到范围编号。
最容易的教学实现给每桶一个列表，按输入先后把完整记录追加过去。也可先统计数量、计算起止位置，再通过交换放成原数组内的连续桶；后者边界管理更复杂。
每桶分别排：短桶拿住下一项、右移更大前项、插入；大桶可再取样划分。若所有值或界限都相等、或者整桶还全落入一个同样大子桶，就停止这条分桶路线，检测全等或换成有最坏保证的排序。例如反复二分小排、比较两排头输出，可保证继续缩小。
从最低范围桶开始，按各桶已经排好的次序输出。无需再跨桶比较，因为界限已确保前桶不会有超过后桶的值。
example: 逐项分类：7>6 进第三桶；2≤6 且≤2 进第一桶；5≤6 且>2 进第二桶；1 进第一；6 进第二；3 进第二。桶为 [2,1]、[5,6,3]、[7]。
第一桶拿住 1、移 2，成 [1,2]。第二桶先 [5,6] 无需挪；拿住 3，依次移 6、5，再写 3，成 [3,5,6]。单项 [7] 保留。
顺次接桶，得 [1,2,3,5,6,7]。没有再加一次样本 2、6，没有漏掉输入项。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数、b 为桶数。用平衡界限树找桶约每项比较 log₂b 次，再移动一次；均衡后大桶不断缩小，良好随机采样通常给期望 O(n log n)。这是一家族，最好取决于桶数、基础方法和数据，不能统一写一个固定最好界。天真版可能 O(n²)，不缩小还可能不结束；检测失败并换有保证方法可给 O(n log n) 最坏。列表版额外 O(n+b) 空间。输入顺序追加且桶内稳定才整体稳定。
zh.why: 一次分出多块，还可把不同桶分给不同工作者。但采样、界限比较、暂存都有成本；样本选偏会把大部分工作留在一个桶。
zh.use: 经常用于并行和分布式排序；在顺序学习中能看清分桶与桶内排序是两件事。
zh.details: 重复界限不能定义相互重叠的归属。全等桶要保留全部记录并直接结束。并行速度还要算工作者数量与传输，不能用这里的顺序工作量直接宣布实际秒数。

foundation: A bucket collects records in a value range; collection alone does not order them. Ranges are arranged so every earlier-bucket key precedes every later-bucket key.
A sample copies a few input values to choose boundaries. Original records still participate once in normal classification; sample copies are not extra output.
Comparing with a middle boundary can eliminate half the candidate buckets.
en.idea: Use a small ordered sample to choose several boundaries, distribute all records into their value ranges, sort each bucket, then read buckets in range order. Bucket membership is determined by comparisons, rather than using integer keys directly as array positions.
steps: Choose b buckets and a sample larger than b. Sort the sample, for example by holding each next value and inserting it after smaller predecessors. Select b−1 roughly evenly spaced sample values as splitters. Oversampling improves balance likelihood, not certainty.
Define where boundary-equal values belong, such as the bucket on the left. For each input record, compare with middle splitters to narrow the possible ranges until exactly one bucket remains.

A simple buffered version appends records to bucket lists in input order. An in-place variant counts bucket sizes, establishes contiguous ranges, and exchanges records into them; that requires additional boundary tracking.

Sort each bucket. For a tiny one, hold its next item, shift larger predecessors right, and fill the opening. Larger buckets may repeat sampling. Detect all-equal buckets and partitions that do not shrink. Finish equals immediately or switch to a guaranteed method, such as repeatedly splitting pieces and joining ordered fronts.
Output the ordered buckets from lowest range upward. No cross-bucket merge is needed because the boundaries already order their ranges.
example: Use [7,2,5,1,6,3] with teaching splitters 2 and 6. The ranges are x≤2, 2<x≤6, and x>6. A sample [7,2,5,1,6] sorts to [1,2,5,6,7], from which 2 and 6 can be chosen. Original 2 and 6 still occur in the input.
Classify in order: 7 goes third; 2 first; 5 second; 1 first; 6 second; 3 second. The buckets are [2,1], [5,6,3], and [7].
Insert 1 before 2 in the first bucket. In the second, 5 and 6 already precede one another; hold 3, shift 6 and 5, then write 3. The ordered buckets are [1,2], [3,5,6], [7].
Read them consecutively: [1,2,3,5,6,7]. Sample values are not appended again.
en.cost: Let n count records and b count buckets. Balanced splitter search takes about log₂b comparisons per item, plus movement. Good randomized samples and shrinking recursion give expected O(n log n). This family has no single best-case formula across all bucket policies and leaf sorters. Naive versions can take O(n²) or fail to shrink; guarded variants can guarantee O(n log n). Buffered lists commonly use O(n+b) extra space. Stability requires order-preserving distribution and stable bucket sorting.
en.why: Many independent buckets reduce later problem sizes, but sampling and storage cost work. Skew can leave most items in one bucket.
en.use: Common in parallel and distributed sorting, and useful for separating distribution from actual internal ordering.
en.details: Give equal values one unambiguous bucket. All-equal detection must retain every record. Parallel elapsed time additionally needs worker and communication assumptions.

zh_alias: 二叉堆排序；堆式选择排序

foundation: 把一排数按层看成树：第一个是根，下层两个是它的孩子，再下层是孩子的孩子。不必创建新树，位置关系就存在数组编号里。
位置从 0 开始时，位置 i 的孩子在 2i+1、2i+2，超过当前项数就不存在。根在位置 0。
最大堆只要求父项不小于孩子。顺着父子关系往下，数不会变大，因此根最大；兄弟或相邻格子却不一定有序。
“下沉”是把过小的父项和较大的孩子交换，再在它新到达的地方重复，而不是重排整个树。
floor 表示向下取整，例如 floor(5/2)=2。查找最后父项时，半个位置不能使用，要取这个整数。
zh.idea: 先让数组符合最大堆的父子规则。最大的数就能立即从第一个格子取出，把它放到末尾固定。将堆缩小一项，令换到根的新数沿一条向下路径寻找合适位置，再取下一个最大值。固定的尾部从右往左增长，最终全排升序。
steps: 先学一次下沉。当前堆有 m 项，某父位置 i 有至少一个孩子时，读它存在的孩子；两个都有就先比孩子，挑较大者 c。若父值≥孩子 c，停止：父值也≥另一个孩子。否则交换父与 c，把 i 改成 c，继续往下。没有孩子也停止。
建堆从最后一个父位置 floor(n/2)−1 开始，依次处理更小父编号，直到 0。底层没有孩子，本来符合规则；从下往上做时，孩子下面的分支已经符合规则，所以上述一次下沉足以整理当前分支。
建好后，交换位置 0 与 m−1。根是剩余最大值，所以它到了全局应在的最右位置，之后不再碰它。令 m 减一，尾部不属于堆。
若 m>1，从根执行下沉。这次只有换入根的数可能破坏父子规则，其他分支内部仍然符合；用一条路径处理就够。
反复取根、缩小、下沉。最后一项自然最小，结束。空输入和单项不用建堆。所有孩子编号检查都使用 m，不要把已经固定的尾部当孩子。
example: [4,1,3,2]，n=4，最后父编号 floor(4/2)−1=1。位置 1 的值 1 只有孩子位置 3 的 2，交换成 [4,2,3,1]。新位置 3 没孩子，停止。
处理根 4：孩子是位置 1 的 2、位置 2 的 3，先挑 3；4≥3，不换。现在是堆，但 [4,2,3,1] 显然不是升序。
根 3 与当前末项 1 交换，成 [1,2 | 3,4]，m=2。根唯一孩子是 2，交换为 [2,1 | 3,4]。
最后交换根 2 与 1，得 [1 | 2,3,4]，m=1，停止。竖线右边每一项都是移过去时就固定的；从未丢掉一个原数。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数。建堆从下到上：很多父项离叶子很近，只需一两次比较，少数靠上项才走较长路径，合计 Θ(n)，不是每项都走到底。取最大值后下沉最多走约 log₂n 层，取出约 n 次，所以通常、最坏 Θ(n log n)；不同键时最好也 Θ(n log n)。本下沉遇相等会停，全等可能 Θ(n)。迭代只用少量编号和交换临时值，额外 O(1) 空间。不稳定，因为根与尾的远距离交换可改变等值记录先后。
zh.why: 选择下一最大值时只看一条树路径，不用重新扫描全部剩余数。但父孩子格子不都相邻，跳跃访问可能比连续归并更不利于缓存。
zh.use: 需要最坏速度保证又不愿分配大数组时很好；也适合给快排混合算法作坏情况后备。
zh.details: “自底向上建堆”别与“bottom-up heapsort”变体混淆：后者可先让大孩子逐层上移到空位，再把拿住的旧根插回路径，以省比较。多叉堆让每父有更多孩子，树更矮却要多比较孩子。

foundation: Read the array as a tree filled level by level. Its first item is the root, followed by its children, then their children. No separate tree objects are needed.
With zero-based positions, i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2 if those positions exist. Root position is 0.
A maximum heap requires each parent to be at least its children. Following a downward path cannot increase the value, so the root is largest. Siblings and neighboring array slots need not be ordered.
Sinking means exchanging an undersized parent with its larger child and continuing from that new position.
Floor rounds down to a whole number: floor(5/2)=2. Array positions must be whole numbers.
en.idea: Arrange the row into a maximum heap, exchange its largest root with the last active item, and exclude that last slot. Sink the new root within the smaller heap, then repeat. Finished largest values accumulate at the right, leaving an ascending result.
steps: First define sinking in a heap of m items. At position i, find existing children. If there are two, compare them and select the larger, c. Stop if the parent is at least c: it is also at least the other child. Otherwise exchange parent and c, set i=c, and repeat. A childless position stops.

Build the heap by sinking parents from floor(n/2)−1 down to 0. Childless bottom items already satisfy the rule. Processing upward ensures each parent’s child branches already satisfy it, so its own single downward path is enough.
After construction, exchange root 0 with m−1. The largest active item has reached its final rightmost place. Reduce m by one and leave that completed suffix outside the heap.
If m>1, sink the replacement root. Other branches remained ordered internally; only the moved root can violate the rule.
Keep exchanging, shrinking, and sinking until one item remains. Empty and singleton inputs need no construction. Child tests must use the active size m rather than the original length.
example: For [4,1,3,2], the last parent is position 1. Its value 1 has just child position 3 containing 2. Exchange them: [4,2,3,1]. The new position 3 has no children.
Root 4 has children 2 and 3. Select larger child 3; since 4≥3, stop. The heap is ready, but [4,2,3,1] is not an ascending row.
Exchange root 4 with final 1: [1,2,3 | 4], active size 3. Select child 3 over 2 and exchange it with root 1: [3,2,1 | 4]. That path ends.
Exchange root 3 with active last 1: [1,2 | 3,4], size 2. Its only child 2 rises by exchange: [2,1 | 3,4].
Exchange 2 with 1: [1 | 2,3,4], size 1. Stop. Every item right of the bar was final when placed there; all original records remain.
en.cost: Let n count items. Bottom-up construction costs Θ(n): many parents need very short paths, while only a few need long ones. Each later extraction sinks along at most about log₂n levels. About n extractions give typical and worst Θ(n log n), also best Θ(n log n) for distinct keys. The stated early-stop rule can give Θ(n) on all-equal input. Iterative control and one exchange temporary use O(1) extra space. The sort is unstable because root-to-end exchanges can change equal-record order.
en.why: The next maximum comes from one path rather than a complete rescan. Widely separated parent and child positions can reduce cache locality.
en.use: Useful when worst-case protection and little extra storage matter; also a fallback inside quicksort hybrids.
en.details: Bottom-up construction differs from the bottom-up heapsort variant, which first promotes larger children along a path and then reinserts the saved root to reduce comparisons. More-child heaps are shorter but inspect more children per level.

zh_alias: Weak-heap sort；经典 n 个反向位实现
en_alias: Weak-heap sort; classic implementation with n reverse bits

foundation: 这里的树编号和普通二叉堆不同：根 0 只有孩子 1；位置 i≥1 的两个物理孩子在 2i、2i+1。物理父编号是把 j 除以 2 向下取整。
每位置多存一个反向位 r[i]，只有 0、1 两种值。位为 0 时，2i 叫逻辑左孩子、2i+1 叫逻辑右孩子；位为 1 则两种名字交换。树格子没搬，改变的是孩子角色。根 r[0] 永远为 0，根没有左孩子，不能把公式的 2×0 当孩子。
子树是从某孩子继续往下能到达的所有位置。最大弱堆要求某节点不小于其逻辑右子树全部值，却不要求大于左子树全部值。根的唯一右子树包含其余全部位置，所以根仍最大。
这里的 join 是一项特定操作：比较两个指定位置，必要时换值并翻一个位。它不是把任意两数比较后就能建立整个弱堆。
a 是这排数的名字，a[i] 就是编号 i 的格子里那项；方括号是在指定位置，不是做乘法。
zh.idea: 普通堆每层通常先挑较大孩子，再与父比较。弱堆通过每位置一个位放松规则，把一些比较得到的信息存下来。建堆、取最大值时，按规定找对比较的两个位置；一次 join 只作一次键比较。省比较的代价是多了一套寻找祖先和读写位的规则。
steps: 先解释特殊祖先。对位置 j，若它是父的逻辑左孩子，向父爬一次；继续爬，直到当前位置是父的逻辑右孩子，此时那个父就是特殊祖先。判断左孩子的方法是：j 的奇偶数（除以 2 的余数）等于父位置的 r 位。匹配就把 j 改成 floor(j/2)；不匹配就返回 floor(j/2)。必须保留原 j 给后面的比较用。
join(i,j)：若 a[j]>a[i]，交换两个值，同时把位置 j 的位从 0 变 1 或从 1 变 0；否则什么也不动。位属于位置，不跟着值搬。翻 j 的孩子角色是这套弱堆规则成立的一部分，不能只交换值而省位。
建堆：所有位设 0，从 j=n−1 逐项倒着走到 1。每次找到原位置 j 的特殊祖先 i，再 join(i,j)。由底往上已经建立的小弱堆逐步接入，最后根拥有最大值。空输入不做这些操作。
排序时，把根与当前最后一项交换，让最大值固定在尾部，当前大小 m 减一。若 m≤1，立即停止这次重建，不准去读位置 1。
若 m>1，从位置 1 向逻辑左孩子下降。当前 j 的该孩子是 2j+r[j]；只要它小于 m 就继续到那里。没有该孩子时达到路径末端。
从末端向上，每次 join(0,j)，然后 j=floor(j/2)，直到 j=0。这里向上走物理父，不是重复找特殊祖先。这条顺序把路径代表的候选值与根逐个比较，重新使根最大。再取出根、缩小、重复。
example: 再 j=2：2 为父 1 的逻辑左孩子，爬到 1；1 是根的右孩子，特殊祖先为 0。比较 3 与根 4，不换。j=1 与根比 2、4，也不换。建堆结束。
交换根与尾，得 [1,2,3 | 4]，m=3。从 1 沿逻辑左孩子到 2。join(0,2) 比较 1、3，交换得 [3,2,1 | 4]，翻 r[2]。再向物理父 1，join(0,1) 比较 3、2，不换；再到 0 停。
最后交换根与另一项，得 [1,2,3,4]，m=1，直接停。绝不能还从位置 1 出发，因为它已不属于当前堆。
zh.cost: 设 n 为记录数。建堆每个非根位置做一次键比较，非空输入恰为 n−1 次，连同找祖先总工作 Θ(n)。经典取出过程反复走约 log₂n 的路径，总最好、一般、最坏 Θ(n log n)。这不意味着全部输入都需要相同交换数。额外必须有 n 个位和 O(1) 控制变量；若每位单独用一个字节，实际要 n 字节。不能写成严格 O(1) 辅助空间。不稳定。
zh.why: 每次 join 不用先比较两个孩子，可能减少昂贵键比较。但奇偶判断、找祖先、翻位、跳跃访存也花时间，因此比较少并不保证机器上最快。
zh.use: 比较很昂贵的专门排序、弱堆优先队列研究，以及理解如何用少量附加信息省比较。
zh.details: 资料可能把逻辑左右镜像命名。必须一起采用本节的孩子公式、特殊祖先条件和取出路径，不能各摘一个公式拼起来。位翻转是改子树角色，不是倒序数组。

foundation: This tree uses different positions from an ordinary binary heap. Root 0 has only child 1. Every position i≥1 has physical children 2i and 2i+1; physical parent j is floor(j/2).

Each position owns a reverse bit r[i], either zero or one. At zero, 2i is its logical left child and 2i+1 its right; at one, the names exchange. Slots do not move. Root r[0] remains zero, and root has no left child.

A subtree includes a child and every position reachable below it. A maximum weak heap bounds a node’s logical right subtree, not its left subtree. Root’s sole right subtree contains everything else, so root remains largest.
The operation join compares two prescribed positions and may exchange values and flip a bit. It does not turn any arbitrary pair into a complete weak heap.
Notation a[i] means the item in slot i of the row named a. Brackets select a position; they do not mean multiplication.
en.idea: Weak heaps save some key comparisons by relaxing ordinary heap rules and recording child roles in bits. Construction and extraction must select the right positions for each comparison. One join compares just two values; ancestor searches and bit handling do the additional bookkeeping.
steps: Find the distinguished ancestor of original position j. Climb while the current position is its parent’s logical left child; stop at the first right-child edge and return that edge’s parent. Numerically, a left edge means (j mod 2)=r[floor(j/2)], where mod 2 is the remainder after division by two. On a left edge replace j by its parent; otherwise return the parent. Preserve the original j for the later join.

join(i,j) compares a[i] and a[j]. If a[j]>a[i], exchange their values and flip r[j] between zero and one. Otherwise do nothing. Bits belong to slots and do not travel with values. Flipping the roles below j is part of correctness.

Initialize all bits to zero. For original j from n−1 down to 1, find its distinguished ancestor i and perform join(i,j). Already built smaller weak heaps are progressively connected until root holds the maximum. Empty input stops directly.
Exchange root with the active last item and decrease active size m. If m≤1, stop restoration immediately; position 1 is no longer an active candidate.
Otherwise descend from position 1 along existing logical left children. At j that child is 2j+r[j]. Descend only when the child position is below m.

From the bottom, perform join(0,j), then move to physical parent floor(j/2), repeatedly until j=0. This upward sequence compares path candidates with root and restores its maximum. Extract again. Do not substitute repeated distinguished-ancestor searches for this physical-parent walk.
example: For [4,1,3,2], bits begin at zero. Position 3 is parent 1’s logical right child, so its distinguished ancestor is 1. Join values 1 and 2: [4,2,3,1], and set r[3]=1.
Position 2 is parent 1’s logical left child. Climb to 1, then follow its right-child edge to root 0. Value 3 does not exceed root 4. Joining position 1’s value 2 with root also changes nothing.
Extract 4: [1,2,3 | 4], size 3. Descend from 1 to left child 2. join(0,2) exchanges 1 and 3 and flips r[2]: [3,2,1 | 4]. Move to physical parent 1; join(0,1) compares 3 and 2 without exchange.
Extract 3: [1,2 | 3,4], size 2. Position 1 has no active left child. join(0,1) gives [2,1 | 3,4] and flips r[1].
The final exchange gives [1,2,3,4], size 1. Stop without visiting position 1 again.
en.cost: Let n count records. For nonempty input, construction uses exactly n−1 key comparisons; ancestor bookkeeping also gives Θ(n) total construction work. Classic extraction repeatedly follows logarithmic-length paths, giving best, typical, and worst Θ(n log n) time, although exchange counts vary. Extra storage is n bits plus O(1) controls; separate byte storage costs n bytes. This is not strict constant-space sorting. It is unstable.
en.why: A join avoids comparing two children before comparing with their parent. Ancestor searches, bit flips, and scattered access can offset the saved key comparisons.
en.use: A specialized option for expensive comparisons, weak-heap priority queues, and comparison-count research.
en.details: Sources may mirror logical left and right. Child formulas, ancestor tests, and extraction paths must use one matched convention. Flipping a bit changes child roles rather than reversing the array.

zh_alias: 胜者树排序；淘汰赛排序

foundation: 想成淘汰赛，比较两位选手时小的赢。比赛只记录谁赢，不会把输的原记录删除。
树的叶子是最下层没有孩子的位置，每条原记录占一个叶子。上面的比赛位置存“哪个叶子赢”，不是多出一份要输出的记录。
某叶子退出后，只有通向顶端的比赛曾依赖它；别的比赛结果仍有效。所以不用从头比较所有选手。
退出用“活跃/不活跃”标记表示，不要随便拿一个数字当永远最大；输入可能真的包含那个数字。
zh.idea: 先让相邻记录两两比赛，再让胜者两两比赛，直到顶端记录最小项。把这一项输出并让其叶子退出，仅重打它向上的比赛。顶端就指出下一最小项，反复输出直到没有活跃记录。
steps: 选择叶子数 P，为不小于 n 的最小二的整数次幂（1、2、4、8、16…之一），n 是输入项数。可以用树格子编号：根为 1，孩子为 2v、2v+1，叶子为 P..2P−1。前 n 个叶子指向原记录，剩余叶子标不活跃。空输入直接结束。
定义一次比赛。两个孩子都不活跃，就让父不活跃；只有一个活跃，就让父记它的记录编号；两个都活跃就比较记录值，父记较小者的原编号。若相等，用原始输入编号较小者获胜，以保留先来先输出。
从最后父位置 P−1 倒着到 1 做比赛。孩子的结果先做好，父才有正确候选；根最后存着全体冠军的记录编号。
读取根编号，输出那条完整原记录。把对应叶子设不活跃，不能仅清掉根；否则下层还会把同一条推上来。
从这个叶子的父位置开始，重新比较它两个孩子的当前结果，再往父的父走，直到根。这些编号每次除以二向下取整。
根若还有活跃编号，就输出新冠军、退出、更新路径；输出 n 条或根不活跃就结束。输出缓冲只按这些冠军逐条增加，比赛树内编号不再额外输出。
example: 输入 [4,1,3,2]，P=4。叶子位置 4、5、6、7 分别指原记录 0、1、2、3。位置 2 比叶子 4、5 的 4、1，记原编号 1；位置 3 比 3、2，记原编号 3；根比 1、2，记编号 1。
根指出值 1，输出 [1]，让叶子 5 不活跃。位置 2 只剩 4，自动记编号 0；根比较 4 与另一边胜者 2，改记编号 3。值 3 的叶子和它的比赛都没必要重做。
输出 2，让叶子 7 退出。位置 3 只剩 3，根比较 4、3，冠军变 3，输出已为 [1,2]。
再输出 3、让叶子 6 退出；位置 3 空了，根自动记左边剩下的 4。输出 4，所有叶子不活跃，结果 [1,2,3,4]。四条输入只各输出一次。
zh.cost: 设 n 为项数，P<2n（n>0）。初建不到 2P 个树位置，工作 Θ(n)。每输出一项沿约 log₂n 个父位置更新，共 n 次，基础完全胜者树最好、一般、最坏 Θ(n log n)。存叶子编号、比赛结果和通常的输出需要 O(n) 空间；不是原地常数空间方法。按原编号处理所有等值比赛则稳定；随意选某边获胜不一定稳定。
zh.why: 每个新最小值只需重打一条路径。保存很多旧比较结果节省重新全扫的工作，但要付树格子、输出和跳跃读取的成本。
zh.use: 反复选择下一最小项，特别是把多条已排序输入流接成一条时很自然：输出某流头之后，只换该流的下一项并更新路径。
zh.details: 败者树是相关结构：比赛位置记录败者，换入选手一路挑战记录的对手，顶端留冠军。外排的替换选择还会把不能接当前输出的项冻结到下一排；这是生成长有序排的步骤，不是这个完整排序的另一个名字。

foundation: Think of a knockout tournament in which the smaller value wins. Losing a match does not delete the original record.
Leaves are bottom positions without children. Each record has one leaf; match positions above store the identity of a winning leaf, not another output record.
When one leaf withdraws, only matches on its path to the top depended on it. Other remembered results remain valid.
Use an active flag for withdrawals rather than inventing a numeric value that might also occur in the input.
en.idea: Compare pairs, then their winners, until the top identifies the smallest record. Output it, withdraw its leaf, and replay only its path upward. The top then identifies the next smallest. Continue until every record has been output once.
steps: For n records, choose P as the smallest power of two at least n, chosen from 1,2,4,8,16,.... A convenient tree uses root position 1, children 2v and 2v+1, and leaves P through 2P−1. Assign records to the first n leaves; mark unused leaves inactive. Empty input stops.

Define a match. With no active child, mark the parent inactive. With one active child, copy its winning record identity. With two, compare their records and retain the smaller identity. On equal keys, the lower original input position wins, preserving arrival order.
Build matches from parent P−1 backward to 1. Children therefore have valid results before their parent is processed. Root finally names the champion.
Output the complete record named by root, then mark its particular leaf inactive. Clearing only root would leave stale lower matches that could promote the same record again.
Starting at that leaf’s parent, recompute each match using the current child winners. Move upward by integer-dividing the tree position by two, stopping after root.
If root still names an active record, output and withdraw it, then update again. Stop after n outputs or an inactive root. Match identities themselves are never additional records to output.
example: For [4,1,3,2], P=4. Leaves 4,5,6,7 refer to original record positions 0,1,2,3. Match position 2 compares 4 and 1, retaining record 1. Match 3 compares 3 and 2, retaining record 3. Root compares those winners and names record 1, value 1.
Output [1] and deactivate leaf 5. Match 2 now automatically promotes its remaining 4. Root compares that 4 with the unchanged other winner 2 and names record 3. Other branches need no replay.
Output 2 and deactivate leaf 7. Match 3 promotes remaining 3; root compares 4 and 3. Output is [1,2], and the new champion is 3.
Output 3, deactivate leaf 6, and make match 3 inactive. Root automatically promotes remaining 4. Output 4; all leaves are inactive. Result: [1,2,3,4].
en.cost: Let n count records. The padded leaf count P is below 2n for nonempty input. Construction visits O(n) positions. Each of n withdrawals updates about log₂n matches, so the basic complete winner tree takes Θ(n log n) best, typical, and worst time. Tree identities and usual output storage require O(n) extra space. Consistent original-position tie-breaking makes it stable.
en.why: Remembered comparisons replace a full rescan for each new minimum with one path. Extra tree storage and indirect reads are the trade-off.
en.use: Useful for repeated minimum selection and joining ordered streams: replace an output stream head with its next record and replay that leaf’s path.
en.details: A related loser tree stores opponents defeated along the path instead. Replacement selection additionally freezes records that cannot continue the current external run; it generates runs and is not another name for this complete sort.
